Hyundai Germany MY27 press text: 13.8 kWh, up to 54 km WLTP combined, 3.8 L/100 km weighted plus 11.4 kWh/100 km (7.1 L/100 km depleted battery, used as cons_l100). Same 3.8 in SE price list. Tank 47 L from SE brochure https://dmassets.hyundai.com/is/content/hyundaiautoever/7556_HYU_MX5_SANTA_FE_digital_se_LR-2pdf-AFpdf (which also shows an older 1.7 L/100 km figure). Battery gross/usable not stated.

ADAC Ecotest 4.3-4.4 L + 12.4 kWh per 100 km; 7.8 L/100 km hybrid mode. Real-world: Motor1 Italy 4.45 L/100 km mixed with charged battery, economical driving, 920 km (https://de.motor1.com/reviews/762244/verbrauch-hyundai-santa-fe-phev/); no credible charge-sustaining real-world figure found.
